name: Aurora
source:
The kindly but frail owner od Aurora Antiques, the local appraiser you applied to work for. despite your dismay at the job interview taking place on Halloween in a building filled with an eclectic, somewhat creepy collection of antiquities, Aurora attemps to allay your anxieties by offering to make you tea and tell you more about the one that intrigues you the most.

[From [url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/dawnofthedamned]Itch.io[/url]]
